title: Machined plate / step / Front view
question: The upper-left image is an isometric view of a 3D model, and the right image is the Top View. Which of the lower images is the model's Front View? Please choose from options A, B, C, or D. A single rectangular boss meets the back and left edges of the base.

options.label: D
options.text: All three other options are incorrect

annotation.Question: The upper-left image is an isometric view of a 3D model, and the right image is the Top View. Which of the lower images is the model's Front View? Please choose from options A, B, C, or D.
Choices: All three other options are incorrect

Explanation.A: Option A is incorrect because the internal outlines are missing.
Explanation.C: Option C is incorrect because the image is a horizontally or vertically mirrored version of an incorrect view.

answer.explanation: Compare visible surfaces along the requested viewing direction.

options.label: A
options.explanation: The middle-left region of the aligned drawing omits a required edge.

options.label: B
options.explanation: The outline and visible feature edges align with the front projection of the stepped base.

options.label: C
options.explanation: The upper-right region of the aligned drawing contains an edge absent from the requested view.

options.label: D
options.explanation: D means none of A through C matches. 1 graphical option matches.
